title: A rapid passing over the 155 mm triangle (Goliath dialect, verify mode)
rationale: Between two grooves the program rapids to (60, 60), over tower 1's corner, at Z = 10. T-TOWER applies to every move, rapids included (safety-model 5.1; the vendor tested only the toolpath). GI cannot express this: goliath-prep replaces a GI program's air moves by its own straight links (safety-model 9.1), and a straight link between two cuts the wheels can reach never crosses the zone. So the case is a vendor-dialect program, which is verified as written.
